sweep.title: Context sweep
sweep.subtitle: Same model, same prompt, growing context: see where generation speed drops.
sweep.hint: Each step sends ~90% of the window as neutral filler plus your prompt, with a 256-token answer cap. Changing the window can make a local server reload the model, so the first TTFT at each size includes load time.
sweep.empty: Run a sweep to see how speed holds up at longer contexts.

info.openrouter: One key for hundreds of models. Many offer free tiers with rate limits.
info.deepseek: Official DeepSeek API: deepseek-chat (V3) and deepseek-reasoner (R1).
info.groq: Ultra-low-latency inference. Free tier with daily rate limits.
info.together: Open-source models API with free trial credit for new accounts.
info.openai: Official OpenAI API: GPT, o-series reasoning and embeddings.
info.xai: Official xAI API for Grok models, OpenAI-compatible.
info.kimi: Moonshot AI platform: Kimi K2 and Moonshot v1 models with free trial credit.
info.nvidia: Free access for NVIDIA Developer Program members (prototyping & testing).
info.ollama-cloud: Run big open models in the cloud with your Ollama account.
info.gemini: Google AI Studio key via the OpenAI-compatibility endpoint. Generous free tier.
info.kilo-gateway: Kilo Gateway: hundreds of models at cost via your Kilo account (app.kilo.ai).
info.modelark: BytePlus ModelArk (Beijing region): Doubao and DeepSeek models via OpenAI-compatible API.
info.poolside: Poolside AI: Laguna foundation models for enterprise development. No public model list — add ids manually.
info.agnes: Agnes AI gateway with free API credits on sign-up.
info.xiaomi-mimo: Xiaomi MiMo gateway: mimo-v2.6-pro, flash and 2.5 models via OpenAI-compatible API.
info.mistral: Official Mistral API (La Plateforme): Large, Medium and Codestral models, OpenAI-compatible.
info.bai: B.AI gateway with a large model catalogue. Model ids are fetched live from the provider.
info.anthropic: Official Anthropic API via OpenAI SDK compatibility: Claude Opus, Sonnet and Haiku with Bearer auth.
